## Description

STEP files with thousands of `GEOMETRIC_SET` items (points/curves) cause slow import because matching uses linear scan.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP with > 10k `CARTESIAN_POINT` / `LINE` / `B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS` entries inside `GEOMETRIC_SET`s.

## Expected kernel behavior

bbox indexing for matching/locating;
